transcript: Hello, Narrator. Please create an image of a beautiful ancient oasis in the middle of a vast desert with tall green palm trees and a shimmering clear pool of water. Then play some desert adventure music.

expectations.description: An image matching the prompt description must be generated and rendered on the canvas.
expectations.criteria: The canvas should show a newly generated image displaying a desert oasis with tall green palm trees and a pool of water in a vast desert landscape.
expectations.success_condition: A generated desert oasis image is visible on the canvas and matches the requested description.

expectations.description: Music from the 'desert adventure' playlist should start playing.
expectations.criteria: The background audio should transition from silent to playing atmospheric/desert adventure style music. The music status bar at the top of the screen should display the active playlist name 'desert adventure'.
expectations.success_condition: Desert adventure music is audible in the final output video, and the music status indicator updates to display 'desert adventure'.

expectations.description: A text message from the agent should appear in the chat sidebar confirming the completed actions.
expectations.criteria: A chat bubble from the agent should appear in the sidebar with a message confirming that the oasis image has been created and the desert adventure music is playing.
expectations.success_condition: The chat sidebar shows a response confirming the creation of the image and the playback of the music.
